interface.shortDescription: 109 local-first MCP tools, 26 skills & 24 agents for Chilean Civil Law.
interface.longDescription: Open Legal Chile is an open-source, local-first legal intelligence plugin for Chilean Civil Law. It bundles 109 MCP tools across official Chilean state and open-data connectors (BCN Ley Chile, PJUD Supreme & Constitutional Courts, CGR, DT, SII, CMF, SMA, TDLC, CNE, Panel de Expertos, Mercado Público/ChileCompra, CPLT/InfoLobby, Diario Oficial, SUSESO, SERNAC, TTA, and INAPI), a hybrid doctrinal corpus & LegalGraphify knowledge graph, 26 specialized legal skills, and 24 domain subagents. Runs locally via uvx with zero client-data leakage and strict statutory citation verification.
